title: Repair conditional-store SO propagation in an isolated generator profile
goal: Fix the demonstrated stwcx./stdcx. CR0 SO propagation error through an explicit, immutable, generator-only derivative while retaining the independent reservation-lifetime failures and leaving startup/shared runtime packages unchanged.
acceptance: Publish a minimal provenance-reviewed patch to the selected conditional-store emitter that copies current XER SO into CR0 on both store outcomes, with no CPU ABI, reservation-validity policy, memory ordering or kernel behavior change

Prepare a fresh private generator using the verified native memory-profile SDK/source read-only and a one-file overlay; bind exact baseline/source/patch/profile/adapter/compiler/binary identities, refuse changed or unapproved inputs, and preserve existing SDKs/generators/packages

Extend the existing reservation diagnostic with an explicit opt-in prepared-generator receipt, preserving default baseline behavior, independent oracle expectations, strict source/library/reference/completion guards and actual generated instruction execution; no game or title startup integration

Compare matched original fixed/seeded/reversed/held-out observations: SO mismatches must disappear on success and failure, unrelated observed state must remain unchanged, and remaining reservation-lifetime failures must remain failures rather than a false compatibility pass
validation: Run baseline and derived actual emitted instruction matrices on Windows/Linux native and supported host/generated sanitizer profiles with three independent comparable processes, reversed order, held-out seed and wrong-result/incomplete controls

Verify repeated and cross-host emission, minimal intended generated differences, unchanged loaded SDK library bytes, preserved baseline receipts and unrelated original CPU fixture emission; reject mutated patch/source/profile/receipt/binary/reference inputs

Run public checks and meaningful positive/negative preparation/selection tests, rehash retained artifacts, measure matched dispatch costs/tails with timer-resolution and instrumentation limits, and document self-review plus separate reservation repair/title-adoption prerequisites
size: one emitter flag assignment plus isolated opt-in preparation and existing diagnostic integration; no shared runtime adoption
